Closed leaf `goldfilled-portly-dungbeetle` (36f4-ae53-2199-42c1). Completion job `1788734260557180387-8dbc9094d6894e34b5f09d0bc1cfd93b` returned substantive PASS at merged revision `ea394c34d13745cc0a14cea968b32f435ef15711`; completion-verifier signature is certified (signed_at 1788734405849032135). All ten AC boxes were marked complete after the PASS. Gerrit 2724 was LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1 / zero unresolved comments and merged; ticket evidence contains the full independent-review TSV plus all DD results under exact `[non-codebase]` tagging.

Close routing note: the configured MCP server is rooted at the dirty primary checkout, whose main branch is 53 commits behind origin/main, so its intentional HEAD-only landing scan could not see the merged commit. The isolated implementation worktree could see it. A worktree-rooted stdio MCP server was used for the transition; its tracker clone's HTTPS origin was process-locally rewritten to SSH for normal ticket delivery, without changing tracker config or the dirty checkout. Close completed `in_progress -> closed`, completion_signature signed=true, push_status=ok; no force and no duplicate verifier run.

Discovered bug `smoggy-republican-saiga` (5623-98ad-dc87-49fa) records that `attach_commits` is ignored by the deterministic landing-presence decision despite being documented as the repair path; linked `discovered_from` this leaf and left open/unclaimed.
